caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object is a pouch or bag with a rounded bottom and a flat top. The fabric of the pouch features a detailed, colorful pattern. The top and bottom edges of the pouch are bordered with horizontal bands containing geometric and floral motifs in red, blue, green, yellow, and white. The main body of the pouch displays a floral design with different types of flowers, including a large yellow flower on the left and a large pink flower on the right, accompanied by green leaves and smaller blue flowers scattered throughout. The overall composition is symmetrical and the colors are vivid, with predominant shades of red, pink, green, blue, and yellow. In the lower right corner of the background, the name "Marion H. Gaskill." is written in green ink. There is also faint text written in the upper right corner.
title: Beaded Bag
